title: Before and After
goal: Use antes de que + subjunctive, después de que + indicative or subjunctive, and the infinitive when the subject stays the same.
grammar: antes de que and después de que

items: I can use antes de que with the subjunctive and después de que with the indicative for facts or the subjunctive for the future.
I can choose the infinitive after antes de and después de when the subject stays the same.
I can use the new words for what comes before and after.
